text:
Jon Rivera: Heads-up — we need to expedite GPU quota for canada-south1 for the new cluster bring-up. ETA for customer pilot is T+3 weeks.
Maria Chen: how many GPUs and which SKUs?
Jon Rivera: Initial request: 24x A10G (or equivalent), 48x T4 for staging, and room to burst +8 A10G later. Need quota in both compute and quota for GPUs-per-region.
Rahul Patel: tagging network constraints too — the new VPC peering will need routes and egress limits. Is this private-only or will we allow public egress for image pulls?
Jon Rivera: private-only for pilot. we'll stage images in our regional registry mirror. KMS must be available in canada-south1.
Tara Singh: cost estimate quick calc: 24 A10G reserved ~ $8k/month committed, staging T4 ~ $1.2k. add networking/egress ~ $400. want to confirm billing code before we raise a support ticket.
Kyle Moore: I can open the quota ticket with the cloud provider — we should include exact QUOTA JSON and a business justification. I'll drop the snippet.
Kyle Moore: ```
{
  "project": "redwood-prod-ops",
  "region": "canada-south1",
  "quota_changes": [
    {"metric": "GPUS", "value": 40, "sku": "A10G"},
    {"metric": "GPUS", "value": 48, "sku": "T4"}
  ],
  "justification": "Cluster bring-up for enterprise pilot. Scale + validation. Need capacity for canary tests and failover."
}
```
Maria Chen: add note about dedicated capacity reservation window (we want a 3mo hold) and reference the capacity-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-reserve
Rahul Patel: also include network CIDRs: `10.50.0.0/16` and peering contact @network-team. Add HSM/KMS requirement: key ring: `redwood-canada-keys`
Jon Rivera: will someone own the cloud support thread and follow up daily?
Kyle Moore: I'll own the ticket. I'll set reminders and post updates here.
Tara Singh: Ops validation checklist I want run post-approval:
- confirm VM SKU availability (gcloud /region-availability)
- provision test instance and run perf smoke (latency + throughput)
- confirm NVLink and driver compatibility
- verify KV cache performance with sample model
- validate egress and registry mirror pulls
Rahul Patel: quick commands:
```
# check gpu quota
gcloud compute regions describe canada-south1 --project=redwood-prod-ops | grep -A3 QUOTAS
# list available accelerator types
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=ca-south1-a --project=redwood-prod-ops
```
Jon Rivera: nice. Can we also add a fallback region policy? If canada-south1 quota delayed, fallback to us-central2 with explicit model-variant routing.
Maria Chen: agreed. add routing policy doc ref: https://redwood.internal/docs/routing-fallbacks
infra-ops-bot: [ticket created] #123456 - Cloud quota request opened (owner: Kyle Moore). Status: awaiting provider acknowledgement.
Kyle Moore: ticket submitted with requested numbers and 3mo reservation note. Provider asked for more detail on expected sustained utilization — I replied with 60% sustained for A10G, 20% for T4 during pilot.
SRE Oncall: I'll add monitoring hooks once capacity is live. Need alert thresholds for GPU temperature and per-node OOMs.
Jon Rivera: timeline check — if provider approves within 48-72h we can start provisioning configs day after. Otherwise we'll pivot to fallback.
Maria Chen: Maria -> Filing internal PR for billing code and cost center for approval now.
Rahul Patel: once approved, I'll run the validation checklist and post results here.
Jon Rivera: perfect. owners: Kyle (quota ticket), Rahul (infra validation), Maria (billing & KMS). I'll coordinate handoff to eng-runtime for deployment. :thumbsup:
Kyle Moore: will update ticket threads and ping here with provider ack or questions.
Jon Rivera: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the bring-up.
Maria Chen: @Jon Rivera noted. :white_check_mark:
